metadata.title: Enforce Max LOC and Class Splitting

story.iWant: automated enforcement of code quality metrics (Max 800 LOC, Max 20 methods)
story.soThat: the codebase remains readable and modular as the agent writes its own code
story.tasks: - [ ] Task 1: Create Lint Script (AC: 1, 2, 3) - [ ] Task 2: Configure Exclusions (AC: 2) - [ ] Task 3: Setup Pre-Commit Hook (AC: 4) - [ ] Task 4: Initial Scan & Plan (AC: 5)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Linter Script: `scripts/lint_check.py` created. 2. LOC Rule: Fails if any file > 800 lines (excluding generated/legacy if marked). 3. Complexity Rule: Fails if any class > 20 methods or Cyclomatic Complexity > 15. 4. Pre-Commit Hook: Git hook or CI step to run this check. 5. Refactoring Plan: Identify current violators (e.g., `chat.py` might be close) and split them.

doc.title: Epic 8 Planning
doc.snippet: Goal: Prevent "God Classes" and unmaintainable code. Rules: Max 800 LOC per file. Max 20 methods per class.

item.reason: Likely violator of LOC rule, candidate for splitting.

story-context.constraints: - Must not break existing build pipeline. - Must allow exclusions for generated code.

tests.standards: Unit test the linter logic using sample files.
tests.ideas: Create a file with 801 lines and assert failure.
